## Description and Rationale

I am a Data Science and AI enthusiast with a strong focus on machine learning, data engineering, and predictive modeling. I decided to join the PRC Data Challenge 2026 to apply my technical skills to real-world air traffic management problems, specifically tackling the complexity of taxi-out time prediction to help optimize airport operations and reduce aviation carbon emissions.
